newsitem.title: USA: Spectranetics to expand laser trial.
newsitem.headline: Spectranetics to expand laser trial.

text.p: Spectranetics Corp said that it has received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to expand its clinical trial for the Spectranetics Laser Sheath for removing pacing/ICD leads implanted in patients.
The company said it has received clearance to increase the number of authorized domestic sites to 35 from 20 and the number of patients to 1,360 from 760.
Pacing leads are the conduit through which pacemakers and implantable cardioverter defibrillator leads regulate the heartbeat with electrical pulses.
Some leads may require removal due to infection, loss of venous flow, product recall or failure.
According to Spectranetics, the old leads have historically been left in place because they are often heavily embedded in fibrotic tissue, making extraction traumatic and potentially dangerous.
